in_marathi.name: Chandrakishor
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon's power, capacity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrakishor हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrakishor is a compound name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Chandra’ meaning moon and ‘Kishor’ meaning power, capacity. The name signifies the one who possesses the power and strength of the moon. This name is associated with wisdom, courage, and prosperity.
